name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for sliding door replacement in an older home?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for sliding door replacement in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for sliding door replacement in an older home, prioritize experience with similar projects. Look for contractors who understand the unique challenges of older home construction, such as potential uneven framing or lead paint/asbestos abatement. Verify they are licensed, insured, and have a strong local reputation, especially in your specific Bay Area community. Review their portfolio, check references, and ensure they provide clear, detailed estimates that cover all aspects of the job, including any necessary permits or structural work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in older homes, local licensing, insurance, and a good reputation. Verify their portfolio, references, and detailed estimates.
